ruleDefinitions.name: File Deletion
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects file deletion using "rm", "shred" or "unlink" commands which are used often by adversaries to delete files left behind by the actions of their intrusion activity

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/rm$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/shred$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/unlink$"))
